1.explanation:
• Checkbox/Checkbox.mdx and Checkbox/docs/overview.mdx contain the API, usage examples, and design guidelines for the Checkbox component; these are the primary docs to update with a new `readOnly` prop and styling details.
• TextInput/TextInput.mdx and its overview show how read-only inputs are styled and implemented elsewhere in the library, providing a pattern to follow for tokens, CSS classes, and RTL test coverage.
• RadioButton/RadioButton.mdx and its overview offer a second example of a togglable form control that already supports read-only (or disabled) states, useful for code parallels in spacing, accessibility attributes, and Storybook controls for playground and default stories.
1.bug_scenario: The bug centers on the missing “read-only” state for the Checkbox component. In the first image we see the standard unchecked, checked, and grouped checkboxes using Carbon’s tokens for text and icon colors. The second image overlays measurements showing that read-only checkboxes should preserve the same structure and spacing (8px padding, 20px between elements, 16px left margin for checked, etc.) but appear non-interactive (grayed border, no hover/focus ring). The read-only variant should disable pointer events, apply a distinct border/text style per the design spec, and be exposed via a new `readOnly` prop in the React component.
